title: Milwaukee Kayak Company
specs: Paddle on Milwaukee, Menomonee, and KK Rivers in downtown Milwaukee
Guided tours include historical insights and city views
Minimum age 12 to paddle own kayak; under 12 must share tandem kayak with adult 18+
All participants must be able to swim
Maximum weight 275 lbs for single kayaks; 475 lbs for tandem kayaks
All participants must be 4 years or older; under 18 must be accompanied by adult 18+
All participants must sign a waiver; parent/guardian must sign for minors
All rentals includes a kayak, paddle, life jacket and brief paddle lesson.
All participants under the age of 12 can share a tandem kayak or canoe with someone age 18 or older.

blurb: Guests rent kayaks, canoes, or paddleboards to paddle on the Milwaukee, Menomonee, and KK Rivers in downtown Milwaukee. Rentals include life jackets and paddles, with options for guided tours and private paddles. The company operates three locations with free parking and offers tours with historical and recreational themes.

groupInfo: Group discounts available for school, community, or special groups
bring: Dress for water temperature; lightweight, quick-dry clothing recommended
Thin-soled shoes or sports sandals; no jeans or heavy cotton
meetingPoint: Main location at Jerry's Docks/Harbor Yards, 318 SOUTH Water Street, Milwaukee, WI 53204
checkin: Thanks for paddling with us, we are looking forward to meeting you soon! If you have any questions along the way, please call or text us at (414) 301-2240. Our main location handles all phone calls and email inquiries and can communicate with our three locations in a timely manner.
cancellation: If you book a 4 hour rental and only stay out for 2 hours, we will not provide a refund (of the difference between a 2 and 4 hour rental options, which is $5). If you need to cancel your reservation for any reason, please let us know by phone or text as soon as you can so we can release your kayaks. CANCELATION INFO: If this trip needs to be canceled due to weather or river conditions, we will notify you by phone and/or email and you can rebook for a different date or receive a full refund, whatever works best for you. Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. If we are out of a color or size you've selected, we will reach out to you as soon as possible to offer an exchange or refund.
